newsitem.title: USA: ChiRex/Sepracor to offer 3.5 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: ChiRex/Sepracor to offer 3.5 mln shares.

text.p: ChiRex Inc and Sepracor Inc said Wednesday that they have filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a public offering of ChiRex's common stock currently held by Sepracor.

The offering consists of 3,489,301 shares held by Sepracor. In addition, the underwriters have the option to purchase up to 523,395 shares from ChiRex to cover over-allotments. The managing Underwriters for the offering are Smith Barney Inc, Credit Suisse First Boston and Legg Mason Wood Walker Inc.

ChiRex supports and supplements the in- house development and manufacturing capabilities of its pharmaceutical and biotechnology customers with a range of fully-integrated services, accelerating the time from drug discovery to commercialization.
Sepracor develops improved chemical entities, which are enhanced versions of existing, widely-sold drugs.
